summary: An original isometric ARPG slice: two full classes, a seeded tile-built wilderness and three-floor crypt, ten enemy types with elite modifiers, two multi-phase bosses, affix loot and crafting, Echo deaths, Veteran/Target Hunt replay, and IndexedDB saves — all procedural art and audio.
notes: Balance and audio were not verified by a human or by ear; the full start-to-Engine flow is covered by simulation tests and partial headless-browser runs. Rapier/Recast/glTF were replaced by a deterministic grid sim and procedural meshes. Restarted from an empty workspace after the first attempt died on a provider error at about 28 minutes. This build is from the second, uninterrupted run.
